_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve heat#1, a catalog-drift correction: the prior 'raises AttributeError' claim was wrong and understated the danger. Measured on 6.2.2604: m.mat + dt*a.mat yields a SumMatrix which HAS an .Inverse attribute, so hasattr checks pass; calling it prints the C++ line 'BaseMatrix::InverseMatrix not available' and RETURNS None, and the next multiply dies on NoneType. The CreateMatrix + AsVector().data form gives a SparseMatrixd whose Inverse works. FURTHER CORRECTION measured here: the claim says the next '* f.vec' dies on NoneType. It does not -- the multiply returns a lazy DynamicVectorExpression and the error only appears at the assignment, as NgException('DynamicBaseScalVec AssignTo not available').
